purpose: Flagged for review: every irregularity and every value that could not be confirmed from an official source. Flagged items are non-blocking and are published here rather than silently filled in. None of them blocks the site; several block strategy qualification.

rows.flag: No official price source exists. The NFL publishes no betting lines, odds or prices anywhere on nfl.com or operations.nfl.com (re-checked 2026-11-15). Every market_open / market_close cell is blank and every ROI figure is uncomputable.
rows.severity: blocks G7 and all staking ROI
rows.source: nfl.com ↗ · 2026 NFL rulebook ↗

rows.flag: Injury-report team misattribution. The official Week 10 injury report renders some players under the wrong club (e.g. J.J. McCarthy under NYG though he is a Vikings QB; Kyler Murray under MIN though he is a Cardinals QB; Micah Parsons and Zaire Franklin under GB though they are Cowboys/Colts). Rows so affected carry attribution_check = 'likely misattributed on source page' and are not used as fact.
rows.disposition: published as rendered with attribution flags; cross-check before use

rows.flag: No depth chart is published. nfl.com/teams/*/depth-chart returns 404 (re-confirmed) and the injury report carries no depth rank. All replacement_depth and replacement_named cells are blank.
rows.disposition: blank by policy; depth tracked only as official designations

rows.flag: Only one injury-capture snapshot exists (2026-11-15). No clock time, no delta, no Wednesday→Friday→kickoff series; designation changes cannot be measured.
rows.severity: blocks Q03, Q15 and surprise injury features
rows.disposition: single snapshot published; multi-day capture is suggestion S-02

rows.flag: Originated fair lines are model outputs, not prices. Home field +2.0 pts is an assumption (no official source), the logistic margin scale 13.5 is uncalibrated, and the fair total is a league-average v1 baseline.
rows.disposition: labeled 'model output — not a bet recommendation' everywhere it appears

rows.flag: Two Week 10 games were live at snapshot time (Rams 31-6 Cardinals Q3; Seahawks 21-10 Raiders Q3) and one was at halftime (49ers 17-16 Cowboys). Scores may change after this snapshot.
rows.disposition: status labeled live/halftime; results feed shows snapshot-time values

rows.flag: Zero strategies qualify and zero reward points are paid. This is the intended result of pre-registered gates, not a bug and not suppressed.
rows.disposition: published openly on the leaderboard pages

rows.flag: Some injury rows have unverified team attribution (e.g. Darnell Mooney under NYG, Za'Darius Smith and Cameron Thomas under ATL).
Week 11 originated lines are pre-game model outputs for games not yet played; no market close exists yet. They are not closing lines and not trading advice.
rows.disposition: published as originated fair lines, flagged model output
